# Factorio Map Generator

A static, backend-free web editor for Factorio map-generation presets. It decodes
and re-encodes the game's map exchange strings byte-for-byte, so a preset edited
here can be pasted straight back into Factorio. It also renders a client-side
preview of the generated map, using a Rust port of the game's own noise
expressions that runs as WebAssembly.

Everything runs in the browser. The app makes no outbound calls.

## Docs

- [Source and README](https://github.com/FactoryGameFan/FactorioMapWebUI): setup, commands, and the local preview-service tool.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/FactoryGameFan/FactorioMapWebUI/issues): known gaps and planned work.

## Reference

- [Factorio map exchange string format](https://wiki.factorio.com/Map_exchange_string_format): the wire format this app reads and writes.
- [Factorio Lua API: noise expressions](https://lua-api.factorio.com/latest/auxiliary/noise-expressions.html): the named expressions the preview reimplements.
